verdict.rationale: The pack only says generically that Navan can "Manage expenses and issue reimbursements." Nothing documents paying employees abroad in their local currency or removing the need for a separate international payments process, which is the core of this story. Reimbursement is a fair axis for a travel-and-expense product, so this is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can reimburse employees abroad in their local currency without running a separate international payments process
